case_study_packaging.headline: Women’s health platform captures $716K in annual savings and 3× ROI through Treya’s rapid strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Advantia Health’s fast-growing, PE-backed network of OB/GYN clinics was buying everything from medical supplies to billing services through disparate systems inherited from recent acquisitions. With no centralized procurement function, spend was fragmented, pricing inconsistent, and EBITDA improvement targets from BlueMountain Capital were at risk. Advantia turned to Treya Partners to quickly uncover and realize meaningful cost savings while maintaining clinical continuity across 50 locations.
approach_summary: Consolidated AP and P-card data from two legacy systems to build a unified $19 M spend baseline and identify 10 high-value categories.
Benchmarked incumbent agreements and negotiated rate reductions—cutting Athenahealth RCM fees to 3.15% and securing a 10% price drop with LabCorp.
Ran competitive RFPs and leveraged GPO pricing to award an enterprise contract with McKesson, delivering 14% savings on medical supplies through distributor consolidation.
Completed make-or-buy analysis on sonography staffing and guided the transition to an in-house recruiting model, lowering costs by 19% while improving coverage.
Standardized purchasing behaviors—such as enforcing ≥5-unit Bayer IUD orders—to eliminate waste and lock in manufacturer discounts across all clinics.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $716,395 in verified annual run-rate savings—$684,936 already implemented and $31,459 pending contract award—equating to a 3.2× return on the $225 K fixed project fee and comfortably exceeding the 2× savings guarantee. Beyond the financial impact, Advantia now benefits from streamlined supply distribution, standardized ordering policies, and the foundation of a data-driven procurement discipline that will sustain future margin expansion.
where_we_were_unique: Generated first dollar savings within 40 days of project kickoff via quick-win IUD initiatives.
Delivered more than 3× ROI, surpassing the contractual 2× savings guarantee.
Deep healthcare expertise unlocked category-specific solutions such as Bayer’s ‘Confidence in Coverage’ program and optimized RCM pricing.
Hands-on data and supplier engagement overcame fragmented systems, enabling fact-based negotiations despite limited internal visibility.

generation_notes: Savings and ROI figures calculated directly from provided impact data and fixed fee of $225K.
